text: And it came to pass, when Saul{H7586} was returned{H7725} from following{H310} the Philistines,{H6430} that it was told{H5046} him, saying,{H559} Behold, David{H1732} is in the wilderness{H4057} of En-gedi.{H5872}

And David{H1732} said{H559} to Saul,{H7586} Wherefore hearkenest{H8085} thou to men's{H120} words,{H1697} saying,{H559} Behold, David{H1732} seeketh{H1245} thy hurt?{H7451}
